input: Refinance my student loans for a lower rate

gold.taskTitle: Refinance Student Loans for a Lower Interest Rate
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to refinance their existing student loans to secure a lower interest rate and potentially reduce their monthly payments or total repayment cost.

questions.title: What is your current total student loan balance?
questions.description: Understanding the total balance helps determine which lenders and refinancing options are most relevant.

questions.title: Are your loans federal, private, or both?
questions.description: Knowing the loan type is critical, as refinancing federal loans into private loans means losing federal protections like income-driven repayment and forgiveness programs.

questions.title: What is your current interest rate on these loans?
questions.description: The existing rate establishes the baseline and helps assess how much savings a refinance could realistically deliver.

questions.title: What is your approximate credit score right now?
questions.description: Credit score is the single biggest factor lenders use to determine the refinanced rate you qualify for.

questions.title: Do you want a fixed or variable rate loan?
questions.description: This shapes which lender products to target and affects long-term payment predictability versus potential short-term savings.

questions.title: What repayment term length are you aiming for?
questions.description: Whether the user wants a shorter term to pay off faster or a longer term to lower monthly payments changes which offers are ideal.

questions.title: Are you currently employed with a steady income?
questions.description: Lenders require proof of stable income to approve refinancing; this also affects the debt-to-income ratio and the rates offered.
